NAVAREA XIX 102/26

Navarea XIX warnings in force as of 18:30 UTC, August 26, 2026 are: 45, 99, 100, and 102.
Navarea XIX 101/26 is canceled.

Navarea xix 103/26

1. Riglist. Correct at 240630 utc aug 26

Norwegian sea: north of 65n, east of 5w.

72-32.70n 020-21.50e - transocean enabler
67-01.65n 005-18.24e - transocean norge
65-17.20n 007-18.10e - island innovator
65-08.00n 006-42.30e - transocean encourage

Notes:

a. Rigs are protected by a 500 metre safety zone.
b. For rigs located south of 65n, refer to navarea i warnings or visit www.ukho.gov.uk/rnw

2. Cancel navarea xix 100/26

NAVAREA XIX 45/26
The Norwegian government has decided that Russian fishing vessels only have access to the following three ports on the Norwegian mainland: Båtsfjord (NOBJF), Kirkenes (NOKKN), Tromsø (NOTOS). A ban on access to other ports on the Norwegian mainland will apply for Russian fishing vessels from 132200 UTC October 2022. Navarea XIX 1/25 is hereby cancelled.

Navarea XIX 99/26
